column2: [intro]
I was a kid, full of hope and dreams,
At the game library, seeking peaceful scenes.
And there I found, like a childhood treasure,
A plastic drum, which would be my pleasure.
The plastic drum, my friend forevermore,
Played melodies in my world of adore.
With my drumsticks, laughter would blend,
This childhood story, I'll never let end.
I took it with me, this faithful drum,
In all my travels, to the place I’m from.
From crowded subways, to Parisian lanes,
Its enchanting sound, gave life to my veins.
The plastic drum, my friend forevermore,
Played melodies in my world of adore.
With my drumsticks, laughter would blend,
This childhood story, I'll never let end.
[ solo ]
So I sing this song, light and sweet,
For all the kids, with stars in their seat.
And maybe one day, another drum will stand,
As the symbol of a dream that won’t disband.
[outro]
